newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shipyard Giessen wins order.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shipyard Giessen wins order.

text.p: Shipyard Van der Giessen-De Noord NV said on Monday it had won an order worth $35 million from Toisa Ltd to build a multi purpose offshore support vessel.
The ship will be used by Toisa's U.K. unit Sealion Shipping Ltd in oil fields in the North Sea and elsewhere.

Together with a previously reported order to build a ferry for the Isle of Man Steam Packet Company, Van der Giessen's order portfolio will take up its production capacity until the middle of 1998, the company said.
It reiterated its previous results forecast. In April it said it expected a modest operating profit in 1997.
